rationale: All 3 prior blocking findings verified resolved directly against the fix-up diff: CR-001 — user_settings.py now calls validate_ms_teams_request(request, SettingType.USER) from both create_user_setting and update_user_setting, making the validator's setting_type != PROJECT guard reachable and USER-scope ms_teams requests are rejected with 400; CR-002 — settings_request_validator.py now types setting_id as 'str | None' and the 'from typing import Optional' import is removed; CR-003 — assistant_ids extraction now requires exactly one non-empty credential_values entry keyed 'assistant_ids' and rejects duplicate ids within the list, closing the empty-list, extra-entry, and duplicate-id gaps. No new problem was introduced by the fix-up itself (SettingType was already imported in user_settings.py; the new duplicate/empty checks run before the ownership check without altering its behavior). 0 deferred, 0 dismissed this round.

finding_status.notes: user_settings.py:145-146,186-187 now call validate_ms_teams_request(request, SettingType.USER) in both create_user_setting and update_user_setting, making the validator's setting_type != PROJECT 400 guard reachable for USER-scope requests.
